hook: Your health history should remember the context.
cta: See how your health history could connect.
thumbnail: Your health data, connected in context
caption: A single measurement fades. The same number with its day, its logs, and its documents stays meaningful. HealthGraph keeps every entry attached to the context it was recorded in, so your history grows connected, not scattered. See how your health history could connect. #HealthGraph #HealthData #HealthTracking #HealthHistory #ConnectedHealth #HealthJournal #DigitalHealth #WellnessTracking #DailyLog

lines.text: Your health history should remember the context.
lines.beat: open on pulse-measurement screen, green sensor trace drawing itself; a '3 OCT' date stamp lands beside 67 BPM · FINGERTIP

lines.text: A single number, like sixty seven beats per minute, fades fast.
lines.beat: isolate the 67 BPM result card on pulse-measurement; everything else dims, camera holds still

lines.text: But it was measured on a specific day.
lines.beat: mono date label '3 OCT' draws a thin line from the measurement into the frame

lines.text: The app remembers the medication you took that morning.
lines.beat: medication card from home-dashboard slides in; a controlled edge line connects it to the measurement

lines.text: The daily log from the same day sits right next to it.
lines.beat: daily-log screen (mood 'Very good', sleep 7h) rotates in; drawn edge closes between it and the measurement

lines.text: And the documents you uploaded belong to the same story.
lines.beat: records-upload screen joins the group; document edge completes the motif

lines.text: In HealthGraph, each piece stays attached to its context.
lines.beat: the four objects (measurement, medication, daily log, document) orbit one small hub node; edges pulse

lines.text: Zoom out, and the connections become a health history.
lines.beat: cut to health-graph screen '12 nodes · 22 connections'; graph edges draw between nodes over time

lines.text: Nothing gets filed away and forgotten.
lines.beat: slow pull-back over health-graph; a node is tapped and its links highlight

lines.text: See how your health history could connect.
lines.beat: end card on warm charcoal with the graph motif behind the CTA
